notes: Account fit: mid-market product analytics SaaS, strong need for fast contextual support chat + semantic search over EU customer docs.
Initial approach: evaluate hosted_api for fast time-to-value; move to Dedicated if residency + throughput needs met.
CTO (Ana-Maria Petrescu) quote: "No PII or customer content leaves the EU perimeter — must be able to prove residency and audit logs."
Key technical asks: EU-region deployment (europe-west), option for multi-region read-replicas, routing policy that prefers EU but fails over to eu-2 only with audit trail.
Latency targets: chat 95th < 120ms (edge to model response after prompt tokenization), embeddings batch throughput ~100 req/s; acceptable tradeoff: +30ms for EU-only routing vs US fallback.
Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit to Dedicated with an annual commit if unit economics clear; wants model/quantization suggestions from Optimize.
POC plan: 2-week hosted_api pilot in eu region, synthetic load test (rps/latency), then Dedicated sizing proposal + pricing scenarios (monthly vs annual commit).
Legal/Sec: needs KMS for key custody, SOC2 type II and ISO27001 on roadmap, data retention controls with per-customer retention windows.
Operational ask: per-route dashboards, token-level cost breakouts in Console, and alerting on quality regressions tied to eval prompt set.
Sales notes: asked for a matrix comparing Hosted vs Dedicated latency/cost at 10k/100k tokens/day.
Follow-ups: deliver EU-specific SLA language for POC; include example canary rollout policy that pins to EU model variant.
